notes.title: 1.22 Ver. Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33017561/a026a5c823bf8a29e46dc6e74065fc106a1c1fdc.png[/img]
[olist]
[*] The version of the game engine received updates from version 2017 to version 2018
[*] Removed unnecessary game files
[*] Added new TAA anti-aliasing
[*] Color correction changed to ACES tonemapping
[*] HDR enabled
[*] Image processing type changed from Gamma to Linear
[*] Interface fixes
[*] A huge increase in productivity, a change in reflection technology
[*] 6 new musical compositions
[/ olist]

notes.title: Insane All games update
notes.content:
[b]1.[/b] All games engines was updated to new version, games now work smooth and perfectly clean
Ne Padai! - [b]2017.4.1f1 [/b]
The last Baron's stunt (Anime) - [b]2017.4.1f1 [/b]
Neon Universe - [b]2017.4.1f1 [/b]
Other Worlds India - [b]2017.4.1f1 [/b]


[b]2.[/b] All games Steamworks libraries was updated to version 13.0, every steam enviroment now works perfect, achievements, progress, etc.
Ne Padai! - [b]SteamSDK 1.46[/b] 
The last Baron's stunt (Anime) - [b]SteamSDK 1.46[/b] 
Neon Universe - [b]SteamSDK 1.46[/b] 
Other Worlds India - [b]SteamSDK 1.46[/b] 

[b]3.[/b] All games was frame locked to avoid image gap/other visual bugs
Ne Padai! - [b]60FPS[/b] 
The last Baron's stunt (Anime) - [b]60FPS[/b] 
Neon Universe - [b]60FPS[/b] 
Other Worlds India - [b]60FPS[/b]
